requirement: Bind the exact artifact SHA-256 to one recorded build invocation and the pinned recipe/source tree.
acceptable_evidence: Signed provenance, retained builder record, or equivalent immutable attestation naming artifact digest, source tree, recipe tree and invocation.
blocking_or_insufficient_evidence: Family/version alignment or repository co-location without digest-bound build provenance.

requirement: Record the build environment, toolchain, dependency inputs and relevant environment variables.
acceptable_evidence: Immutable environment/toolchain/dependency manifest sufficient to identify the producing build context.
blocking_or_insufficient_evidence: Unbounded current environment, undocumented host state, or package metadata alone.

requirement: Bind package outputs and named runtime members to the attested build result.
acceptable_evidence: Output manifest linking package digest and named member digests/paths to the build result.
blocking_or_insufficient_evidence: Receipt-only member observation with no producing-build link.

requirement: Provide an independent verification path for the artifact-to-recipe claim.
acceptable_evidence: Independent byte reproduction, reproducible-build comparison, or independently verifiable signed provenance.

requirement: Define failure, update and rollback handling for attestation continuity.
acceptable_evidence: Policy showing how successor and rollback artifacts retain or re-establish the same provenance chain.
blocking_or_insufficient_evidence: One-off proof that cannot govern update or rollback.

requirement: Enumerate every recipe delta and packaging hook in the pinned recipe root.
acceptable_evidence: Complete file-by-file delta inventory covering patches, custom steps, hooks, subpackages and configuration arguments.
blocking_or_insufficient_evidence: Token presence alone or partial recipe excerpts.

requirement: Compare the pinned recipe behavior against the identified upstream baseline.
acceptable_evidence: Semantic comparison explaining what each delta changes relative to upstream.

requirement: Classify each delta as Android/Termux-required, packaging-only, maintenance-only, optional, or unrelated.
acceptable_evidence: Reasoned classification with evidence tied to platform constraints or package behavior.
blocking_or_insufficient_evidence: Assuming every Termux recipe change is runtime-required adaptation.

requirement: Bind each accepted delta to the affected named runtime object or explicitly show no object impact.
acceptable_evidence: Object/member-level impact analysis linked to the 37 reviewed identities.
blocking_or_insufficient_evidence: Package-wide inference from a recipe-level change.

requirement: Define update and rollback implications of accepted adaptations.
acceptable_evidence: Compatibility and continuity requirements for successor and rollback recipe/artifact states.

requirement: For roots with no explicit bounded token, perform a full semantic review rather than infer upstream equivalence.
acceptable_evidence: Complete recipe/upstream comparison showing whether any implicit or unclassified adaptation exists.
blocking_or_insufficient_evidence: Treating absence of collector tokens as proof of no adaptation.

requirement: Show consumers bind to the expected SONAME or stable alias rather than the historical concrete filename.
acceptable_evidence: Consumer/reference evidence or loader-policy evidence demonstrating stable SONAME/alias binding.
blocking_or_insufficient_evidence: SONAME equality of the provider object alone.

requirement: Validate the package symlink chain and concrete target across the exact current artifact.
acceptable_evidence: Exact alias-to-target chain, target digest and target SONAME bound to the reviewed artifact.

requirement: Define how successor versions may change the concrete target while preserving the accepted runtime identity.
acceptable_evidence: Explicit version-drift acceptance rule with validation gates.
blocking_or_insufficient_evidence: Copying the first-generation concrete filename as a permanent oracle.

requirement: Define rollback behavior when concrete targets differ between versions.
acceptable_evidence: Rollback rule preserving alias/SONAME identity and exact artifact/member verification.

requirement: Correct the required object identity or locate a candidate providing the required expected SONAME.
acceptable_evidence: Authoritative workload/reference evidence correcting the requirement, or an exact artifact/member candidate with the required SONAME.
blocking_or_insufficient_evidence: Substituting a different ABI family such as libjpeg.so.8 for libjpeg.so.62.
